title: UK consultation scheduled-for dates
summary: Consultation Scheduled for dates now show and accept UK dd/mm/yyyy in Europe/London, so 5 March is not stored as 3 May.
changes: Display consultation scheduled-for times as dd/mm/yyyy HH:mm:ss in Europe/London.
Accept UK slash dates on create and update, and keep stored UTC timestamps unchanged.
affected_areas: Consultation scheduled-for create and update forms
version_rationale: Patch release: corrects UK date display and input for an existing consultation field without changing stored UTC timestamps.
validation: PHPUnit UkDateTimeTest and PetCareConsultationWorkflowTest cover UK day/month order, Europe/London display, and invalid dates.
php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main on the PR branch.
known_limitations: Other guest and staff date fields outside consultation scheduled-for are unchanged and remain later Public UX follow-ups.
rollback: Redeploy the previous application version to restore ISO datetime-local scheduled-for inputs and UTC wall-clock display.
provenance: UK consultation scheduled-for date format fix for issue #132, pull request #198.
